statement: The closest existing work is the cluster that manipulates a multi-triple set around a target fact: arxiv:2609.10237 (holds triple count fixed and swaps non-chain triples), doi:10.20944/preprints202505.1992.v1 (merges and orders triplets), arxiv:2202.13296 and doi:10.18653/v1/2020.emnlp-main.99 (subgraph as model input), arxiv:2101.03737 and doi:10.1145/3336191.3371812 (intermediate/stepwise supervision). These overlap on the problem (multi-hop QA over KG facts) and on the manipulation of which triples accompany a target, but none runs the idea's exact contrast: training-time fine-tuning with isolated triples versus passage-derived context triples at matched budget. No directly matching work was found in the searched literature.
